newsitem.title: USA: Equity Oil says board approves buyback.
newsitem.headline: Equity Oil says board approves buyback.

text.p: Equity Oil Co said Monday it would buy back up to 650,000 of the Company's outstanding shares over the next six months.

"While our shares continue to trade significantly below year-end 1996 net asset value we believe they are an excellent investment, particularly in view of the success we are continuing to see this year from our aggressive program to further build North American reserves through highly focused exploration drilling, exploitation of existing assets and acquisitions," said chief executive Paul Dougan in a statement.
The Company said that shares may be purchased from time to time either in the open market or through negotiated transactions as market conditions warrant.
